name: l0_world_sweep_query
about: The two primitives of the oriented-box clip `FUN_10241620` 0x10241620's hull path (`walks/L0-r011.md`): `ClearTrace` 0x1023f3d0 -- `startpos = start + startOffset`, `endpos = start + delta`, `fraction = 1`, `contents = 0`, `allsolid = startsolid = 0` -- then the segment/sphere early-out 0x1023ffa0 with `r1 = sqrt(|extents|^2) + sqrt(|half|^2)` and `r2 = tolerance`: `p = dot(C - A, D)`; `p > 0` gives `t = p <= |D|^2 ? p/|D|^2 : 1`, else `t = 0`; `Q = A + D t`; the answer is `(r1 + r2)^2 < |Q - C|^2 ? 0 : 1`, a STRICT compare. Cases, each one `entity_call Sweep_HullPrelude` on the utility `sweep`: (touch) a unit-radius box 2 units beside a ray of extent 1 -- `dist == r1 + r2`, overlap 1; (outside) the same box one unit further, 0; (negative) `r1 = 1`, tolerance -3 -> `rs = -2`, `rs^2 = 4`: a centre 1.5 units away still overlaps (the sum is squared with its sign); (behind) a centre behind the start gives `p < 0`, `t = 0`, the closest point is A; (zero D) a zero-length ray gives `p = 0`, `t = 0`; (past end) a centre past the end gives `p > |D|^2`, `t = 1`. Every call first writes the clear trace (`end = start + delta`). Reported as `fail`, a payload differs from retail's arithmetic.

expect.label: touch_clear
expect.match: va=0x1023f3d0 phase=write start=0,0,0 end=10,0,0 fraction=1 contents=0 allsolid=0 startsolid=0

expect.label: touch
expect.match: va=0x1023ffa0 phase=return p=50 t=0.5 dist2=4 rs2=4 result=1

expect.label: touch_done
expect.match: entity_call Sweep_HullPrelude done prelude=pass fraction=1 end=10,0,0

expect.label: outside
expect.match: ^tag=segment_sphere fn=FUN_1023ffa0 va=0x1023ffa0 phase=return p=50 t=0\.5 dist2=4\.004 rs2=4 result=0

expect.label: outside_done
expect.match: entity_call Sweep_HullPrelude done prelude=miss fraction=1 end=10,0,0
